session_header.goal: Independently audit immutable generation, worker isolation, public/private split, model-binding honesty, benchmark succession, and consolidation design.

task_ledger.description: Verified v2.4 overlay identity, active cohort/generation, generation SHA, control and assignment blob bindings from ps/v2.4-control-release.
task_ledger.next_action: MM06 should independently re-observe the generation head and every worker branch after worker writes complete.

task_ledger.description: Verified the generation branch remains exactly at the recorded generation head and all 25 files in the frozen control manifest match their generation-SHA Git blob identities.
task_ledger.next_action: Do not move the generation ref; any movement invalidates the cohort.

task_ledger.description: All 12 expected worker branches exist with merge-base equal to the frozen generation SHA. At audit time 11 were still identical to G; MM01 was exactly one commit ahead and changed only its own report path.
task_ledger.next_action: MM06 must later verify each completed worker branch head and enforce one-report-only path isolation.

task_ledger.description: EXT01 capability commitment matches the frozen public commitment and the cohort-bound HMAC was computed; assignment is replay-only with no private manifest or protected evidence IDs.
task_ledger.next_action: MM06 independently recomputes the HMAC using verifier-side secret material.

task_ledger.description: Benchmark succession is explicitly independent per program and successor-gated. Single-PR consolidation design is coherent, but no consolidation branch/PR exists yet and merge-policy enforcement is not fully frozen by the generation manifest.
task_ledger.next_action: BIL00 should freeze or explicitly bind the merge/lineage guard implementation and then prove one expected-head/state-lineage-protected consolidation PR.

issue_ledger.summary: v2.4 consolidation relies on semantic CI/parent-lineage guard files that are present at the generation SHA but are not included in the frozen control manifest.
issue_ledger.fix_or_next: Freeze these merge-policy/lineage enforcement files in the next branch control manifest or bind their exact blob identities in a separate immutable merge-policy manifest consumed by consolidation.

issue_ledger.summary: Overlay state calls the network mode GITHUB_BRANCH_CALIBRATION while the frozen v2.3 assignment schema/assignment encode GITHUB_BUS_CALIBRATION; the transport overlay/base-mode split is not machine-explicit.
issue_ledger.fix_or_next: Add an explicit overlay_transport_mode field/schema or extend the assignment mode enum in the next control revision; do not make downstream equality assumptions across overlay/base network_mode fields.

issue_ledger.summary: Repository branch-protection/ruleset enforcement for main and immutable generation refs was not independently observable through the available connector; protocol-level branch isolation is therefore stronger than proven GitHub permission isolation.
issue_ledger.fix_or_next: Require PR/status-check protection on main and lock/restrict ps/gen/* where supported; document the active ruleset/protection identity or independently re-check generation head at verification and merge time.

issue_ledger.summary: Requested model identity is known in this runtime, but the Scheduled Tasks surface does not expose an independent reasoning-effort receipt; model binding is therefore only PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED.
issue_ledger.fix_or_next: Keep model-sensitive fresh promotion disabled unless a future frozen execution manifest and runtime receipt independently bind both model and required reasoning configuration.

Verified all 12 expected worker branches share the exact generation merge-base; the only completed worker branch observed so far changed only its own report file.
test_ledger.result: 12/12 branches present; no observed cross-worker file write.

test_ledger.result: Commitment match; HMAC proof format valid.

test_ledger.description: Verified calibration assignment carries no private manifest and no protected/fresh evidence IDs for EXT01.

test_ledger.description: Did not claim verification of an effort setting not exposed by the task runtime.
Verified Mastermind and Math Foundry have independent active cursors and explicit successor chains with verified-completion/preflight requirements.
test_ledger.result: Independent succession rules present; exhaustion enters BENCHMARK_DISCOVERY_WAIT.

test_ledger.description: Protocol/schema specify one consolidation branch and PR with expected-head/state-lineage guard, but the branch/PR has not yet been created in this cohort.
test_ledger.result: Design present; end-to-end merge safety not yet demonstrated.

test_ledger.description: Queried combined status surface for the frozen generation commit.
test_ledger.result: No connector-visible statuses observed; recorded as CI_NOT_OBSERVED, not PASS.

HMAC commitment and replay-only privacy boundary pass.
Binding reported PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED; no fresh model-sensitive claim.

evidence_and_provenance.notes: Audit used the v2.4 control-release pointer and exact generation SHA, not mutable main. Main was consulted neither as worker control nor as scientific evidence.

claim_scope: Replay-safe Branch-GitOps transport/control audit only. No fresh or protected benchmark evidence, no benchmark execution, no deep research, no scientific uplift, and no Foundry/Mastermind runtime modification or promotion.
runtime_implementation_implication: NONE. The branch overlay isolates transport writes and preserves runtime authority separation. Findings concern control/merge hardening only.
